newsitem.title: JAPAN: Two Osaka shinkin banks to hold briefing on merger.
newsitem.headline: Two Osaka shinkin banks to hold briefing on merger.

text.p: Two credit associations based in Osaka, western Japan, said that they will hold a joint news conference at 1 p.m. (0400 GMT) on Friday about a merger.
The two are Osaka Shinkin Bank and Sanwa Shinkin Bank.
Shinkin banks are larger than credit unions but are not classified as "banks" under Japanese financial laws.
They lend money mainly to members but take deposits widely. Most borrowers are small- and medium-sized businesses.
Unlike credit unions, they are monitored by the Finance Ministry.
